package.name: actuation
package.description: Actuation layer. sim_backend (Phase 1/3) takes the policy engine's BehaviorCommand from core/cmd and forwards movement to the simulated robot's /cmd_vel, plus MVP voice/face stand-ins. hardware_backend (Phase 5, optional) implements the same core/cmd interface for real motors via a pluggable MotorDriver (gpiozero example provided; see docs/hardware.md). Neither backend is required by the other - the launch file's `backend` argument picks one.
